messages:
maria-cs: :rotating_light: Aurora Labs (dedicated) reports streaming responses truncate mid-generation on regen endpoint. They say ~8/10 attempts return a partial stream with no final event. High ARR customer, blocking GA. Repro + logs below. Please advise next steps.

sam-eng: can you paste the exact curl/request and model/version? also which dedicated pool?

maria-cs: they're on dedicated-eu-1, model pinned to gpt-4o-redwood-v1, prompt ~1.5k tokens + max_tokens=800. Repro curl: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-redwood-v1","input":"<long prompt ~1.5k tokens>","stream":true,"max_tokens":800}' \
  https://dedicated-eu-1.redwood.ai/v1/outputs/stream
```
Observed: stream sends partial reasoning then stops after ~120 tokens. No final event. Customer logs: 
```
[2026-03-19T16:02:03Z] conn=0x3f2a partial_response id=aa3f... len=123
[2026-03-19T16:02:03Z] conn=0x3f2a kv_cache_size=0
[2026-03-19T16:02:03Z] conn=0x3f2a connection_closed by client? code=0
```

maria-cs: they say immediate retry often succeeds. No 5xx from our side. Customer blocked from launch. Marked P1 on their side.

alex-prod: thanks. quick asks before routing: can we get a minimal prompt that reproduces? does this reproduce on hosted API? attach org id & request id.

maria-cs: minimal prompt pasted above. org id aurora-org-772. request id from their logs: req-0a7b9c. Repro ~80% on their dedicated, ~10% hosted.

sam-eng: initial hypotheses: streaming flush path or connection abort when kv cache grows. I'll try reproducing on a staging dedicated emulator. tagging eng-triage.

sam-eng: (30m later) did a quick run on staging: I got partial responses but staging worker returns stream-complete. difference: their nginx ingress timeout is 60s in customer's values. could be proxy idle timeout.

ev an-sales: Aurora says they didn't change infra, using our standard dedicated. they claim other vendors stream fine.

sam-eng: need deeper info. options: 1) request tcpdump/pcap, 2) run controlled repro with a debug build in their org, 3) remote debug session. I prefer 2.

alex-prod: agree. Maria, coordinate a debug window & debug key. capture headers: Connection, Keep-Alive, Transfer-Encoding.

maria-cs: scheduled debug window tomorrow 09:00 UTC. customer will run tcpdump if we provide exact commands.

sam-eng: I'll prepare a debug image with extra logging around stream finalization and connection-close reasons. ETA EOD. If they can't run custom image, fallback to proxy-capture.

ci-bot: Deploy started: job eng/debug-stream-2026-03-19 #482 -> staging (ephemeral)

alex-prod: once we have logs, we decide infra (proxy) vs runtime (kv/cache/tokens) vs customer network. If infra/runtime, escalate to eng-runtime and plan quick patch + rollback. If customer network, write KB + mitigation.

maria-cs: note legal & SLA team reached out. Need ETA communicated by EOD.

sam-eng: opening ticket ENG-TRIAGE-1147, labels: p0-customer-blocking, source: customer-success. will attach repro steps + logs + test case.

ev an-sales: product workaround idea: force periodic chunk flush or enable chunked transfer if missing. could be quick mitigation to reduce customer impact.

sam-eng: possible low-risk mitigation: force SSE event flush every 500ms even if no new tokens; will experiment in debug build.

alex-prod: schedule daily check-in 11:00 UTC tomorrow. Maria, update customer and include ETA if we have debug image.

maria-cs: will update and confirm tcpdump commands. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
